title: Web Component
tagline: Run an app in any web page as the custom element <abap2ui5-app>.
summary: An alternative abap2UI5 frontend built on UI5 Web Components, without the UI5 core: one ES module and one custom element, <abap2ui5-app>, that runs an unchanged abap2UI5 app class standalone or embedded in any web app - React, Vue, Angular or plain HTML - in its own shadow root and backend session. It renders the controls of the portable view profile of the abap2UI5 protocol; a control outside it shows as a visible box.
useWhen: Use when an abap2UI5 app has to run in a web page without the UI5 core - React, Vue, Angular or plain HTML - as the custom element <abap2ui5-app>; the ABAP app class stays unchanged and has to keep to the controls of the portable view profile.
features: One ES module and one custom element: <abap2ui5-app endpoint="/sap/bc/z2ui5" app="Z2UI5_CL_MY_APP">
Standalone page or embedded in React, Vue, Angular or plain HTML, in its own shadow root
The core protocol in full: events, model deltas, sessions, popups, the app stack, the URL hash
All 65 controls of the portable view profile v1; anything else renders as a visible unsupported-control box
Reports what happens as DOM events
requirements: An abap2UI5 backend reachable from the page's origin
Views built from the controls of the portable view profile

notes: Nothing to install on the system: build dist/abap2ui5-wc.js with npm and load it in your page
